items.title: 15.5 Basic organization of human nervous system (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the organisation of the nervous system (PDF 36).

blocks.text: Insani nervous system ke do hisse hain: central nervous system (CNS), yaani dimagh aur spinal cord, aur peripheral nervous system (PNS), yaani dimagh se nikalne wali cranial nerves aur spinal cord se nikalne wali spinal nerves.

Nerves sensory aur motor raaste banati hain. Motor raaste do hain: iradi (somatic) nervous system, jo skeletal muscles chalata hai, aur autonomic nervous system, jo ghair iradi muscles aur glands chalata hai; autonomic system ke sympathetic aur parasympathetic hisse hain.

blocks.alt: Darakht-numa chart. Nervous system ke do hisse: Central nervous system (Brain, Spinal cord) aur Peripheral nervous system (Sensory pathways, Motor pathways). Motor pathways ke do hisse Somatic nervous system aur Autonomic nervous system; autonomic ke do hisse Sympathetic aur Parasympathetic nervous system.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.8: Nervous system ki bunyadi tanzeem (kitab ki Figure 15.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Dil ki dharkan kaunsa hissa qaboo karega, aur haath uthane ka faisla kaunsa?
blocks.explanation: Dil ki dharkan: autonomic nervous system (ghair iradi). Haath uthana: skeletal muscles par chalne wala somatic (iradi) nervous system.

items: CNS: dimagh aur spinal cord. PNS: cranial aur spinal nerves, sensory aur motor raaston mein; motor = somatic (iradi) + autonomic (sympathetic, parasympathetic).
